description: This file defines a class 'RemotePortTunnel' that manages SSH port forwarding tunnels for remote access. It handles creating, terminating, and monitoring SSH processes, port allocation, parsing configuration files, and logging.

classes.name: RemotePortTunnel
classes.description: A class that manages SSH tunnel processes for remote port forwarding, including creation, cleanup, and port management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and starts an SSH port forwarding tunnel with specified remote and local ports, handling configuration and logging.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the SSH tunnel process and cleans up associated resources.
